attention.settings.title: Email and notifications
attention.settings.help: Add an address to receive emails from this wiki. It is only used for notifications and is never shown to other people.
attention.settings.mail_off: This wiki does not send emails at the moment; your choices apply once an administrator sets up email.
attention.settings.email_hint: Leave empty to receive no emails.
attention.settings.attention_emails: Email me when requests need my review
attention.settings.attention_emails_hint: How often depends on the wiki's settings (right away, as a digest or once a day).
attention.settings.decision_emails: Email me when a request of mine is approved or denied
attention.status.email: Email me when my account is reviewed
attention.status.hint: Optional. You can change or remove it later in your account settings.
attention.status.saved: Saved. We will email you when an administrator decides.
attention.unsubscribe.title: Email notifications
attention.unsubscribe.confirm.attention: Stop the emails about requests waiting for your review?
attention.unsubscribe.confirm.decisions: Stop the emails about decisions on your requests?
attention.unsubscribe.done.attention: You will no longer receive emails about requests waiting for your review.
attention.unsubscribe.done.decisions: You will no longer receive emails about decisions on your requests.
attention.unsubscribe.settings_hint: You can turn emails back on at any time in your account settings.
attention.admin.title: Notifications
attention.admin.intro: Decide how administrators and reviewers hear about requests waiting for them, and how this wiki sends email.
attention.admin.mail_missing: Email is not set up yet: nothing is sent until a mail server is configured below.
attention.admin.enabled: Email administrators and reviewers when requests are waiting
attention.admin.enabled_hint: Sent to everyone who can act on a request and has an email address in their account settings (administrators with an address: {count}).
attention.admin.mode.digest: A digest when new requests arrive, at most every N minutes
attention.admin.daily_hour_hint: In the wiki's time zone. Used by the daily mode.
attention.admin.decisions: Email people when their request is approved or denied
attention.admin.decisions_hint: Covers sign-ups, quota requests and proposed edits. People without an address still see a notice in the wiki.
attention.admin.base_url_env: Links in emails point to {url} (set by the host with BW_BASE_URL).
attention.admin.base_url_hint: Used for links in emails, for example https://wiki.example.org.
attention.admin.opt_out_hint: Everyone can turn these emails off in their account settings or with the link in each email.
attention.admin.mail_env: Email is configured by the host ({provider}, sender {sender}). Change it with the BW_MAIL_* and BW_SMTP_* environment variables.
attention.admin.mail_host_only: On this hosting, email is provided by the host. Ask the platform administrator to enable it.
attention.admin.from_hint: The address emails come from; your provider must allow it.
attention.admin.security.none: None (only for a server on this machine)
attention.admin.secret_set: Stored encrypted. Leave empty to keep it.
attention.admin.env_hint: Hosts can set all of this with environment variables instead (BW_MAIL_PROVIDER, BW_SMTP_HOST, ...); those take precedence.
attention.admin.test_help: Send a test message to your own address ({address}) with the settings saved above.
attention.admin.test_no_address: Add an email address to your account to send yourself a test message:
attention.admin.test_rate_limited: Too many test emails. Try again in an hour.
attention.admin.test_failed.not_configur: The mail server is not configured.
attention.admin.test_failed.no_address: Your account has no email address.
attention.admin.test_failed.invalid_addr: Your email address is not valid.
attention.admin.test_failed.invalid_head: The message could not be built (invalid characters in the sender or subject).
attention.admin.test_failed.provider_err: The email provider refused the message. Check the API key and sender address.
attention.admin.test_failed.provider_unr: The email provider could not be reached.
attention.admin.test_failed.smtp_failed: The SMTP server refused the message or could not be reached. Check the server, port, encryption and credentials.
attention.admin.test_failed.smtp_require: A password is only sent over an encrypted connection; choose STARTTLS or SSL/TLS.
attention.admin.test_failed.recipient_li: Too many emails to this address today.
attention.admin.test_failed.daily_limit: The daily email limit has been reached.
attention.admin.error.base_url: The public address must be a full http(s) address such as https://wiki.example.org.
attention.admin.error.number: Enter a whole number between {minimum} and {maximum}.
attention.admin.error.mode: Choose one of the listed options.
attention.email.footer: You receive this email because of your account on {site}.

attention.email.intro_daily: Hello {username}, this is what is waiting for your review on {site} today:
attention.email.subject: {site}: requests waiting for your review ({count})
attention.email.decision_intro: Hello {username}, there is news about a request you made on {site}:
attention.email.test_body: This is a test message from {site}. Email notifications can be delivered.
